name: @busy/ui
//: Every component is its own entry point. There is no index that re-exports the set, because a barrel file makes `import { Button } from '@busy/ui'` pull the whole library into a bundle that wanted one button — and because it becomes a second list of what exists, alongside the folder, that somebody has to remember to update. `@busy/ui/Button` is the file, and the file is the truth.
